questions.prompt: Is there a defect in the order of operations in invalidate? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A node receives an Invalidation message from another node. What does onInvalidation do?
choices: Deletes the shared entry and the local entry
Reloads the settings from the repository into the local cache
Removes only the node's own local entry for that channel
Publishes the message again so every node receives it

questions.prompt: How long can a channel's settings remain in the shared cache without any invalidation?
choices: Until the repository changes, because Caffeine evicts on writes

questions.prompt: Two threads on the same node call get for the same uncached channel at the same moment. What happens?
choices: Both call loadShared and race to write the local cache
The local cache runs loadShared once, and the other thread waits for that result
Both receive an exception because the key is being computed
